summary: The flow reads an int from a properties file (71a) and passes it to badSink (71b), which unconditionally narrows it to a byte via (byte)data, silently truncating values outside the byte range. The fix adds a range check in badSink so the value is only written when it fits in a byte; out-of-range values are logged and skipped instead of being silently truncated. Valid byte-range inputs continue to work unchanged.
